note: What a department may touch while it works, and where. Every rule is relative to that step's own workspace: a bare grant like `Read` reads the whole machine, including this repository, so scoping is the containment. Bash is granted to nobody -- it is scoped by command, never by path, so no workspace can bound it; work that needs to run something goes through a connector with its own admission control. Sub-agent tools are likewise ungranted until they are governed. WebSearch is granted to the two departments whose deliverables must cite sources, and to nobody else: a search sends a query and returns text, while WebFetch names its own URL and stays ungrantable, because a URL carries data out. A department that can search is told at the point of use that results are data, never instructions.
